scheme_name: Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers scheme is an initiative by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was launched on 1st April 2015.

It aims to provide financial support to women workers and the daughters of workers in Haryana.

The primary objective of this scheme is to assist in the marriage of women workers or their daughters.

The scheme intends to alleviate the financial burden associated with marriage expenses.

The government has set a measurable target of providing assistance to at least 10,000 beneficiaries annually.

The assistance amount under this scheme is fixed at INR 51,000 for each eligible applicant.

This financial aid is intended to cover various marriage-related expenses.

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and clearly defined.

Applicants must be residents of Haryana.

The applicant must be a woman worker or the daughter of a registered worker.

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There is no upper age limit specified for applicants.

Additionally, the applicant must belong to a family with an annual income not exceeding INR 3 lakh.

This income criterion ensures that the assistance reaches those who are in genuine need.

To apply for this scheme, applicants must follow a specific process.

The application form can be obtained from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website.

Applicants must fill out the form with accurate personal details.

The required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID.

Applicants must also provide proof of residence.

A certificate of the applicant's age is necessary.

Additionally, a marriage invitation card or a certificate of marriage is required.

The application form must be submitted to the nearest Labour Welfare Office.

The completed application should be submitted along with all necessary documents.

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The processing time for applications is typically around 30 days.

Disbursement of funds is made directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The financial assistance is provided in a single installment.

This ensures that the funds are available to the applicant at the time of marriage.

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

For any inquiries, applicants can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is available on the official website.

The board also conducts awareness programs to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme.

This outreach is crucial for ensuring that eligible women and their families are aware of the assistance available.

The scheme has seen a steady increase in the number of beneficiaries since its inception.

In the financial year 2020-2021, over 12,000 applications were received.

Out of these, approximately 10,500 applications were approved.

The scheme has been instrumental in supporting families during the marriage of their daughters.

It has contributed to reducing the financial stress associated with marriage expenses.

The Haryana government has allocated a budget of INR 10 crore for this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to supporting women and their families.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to empower women in Haryana.

It aligns with various national policies aimed at improving women's welfare.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continuously monitors the implementation of the scheme.

Regular audits are conducted to ensure transparency and accountability.

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further.

The government encourages beneficiaries to share their experiences.

This feedback helps in refining the application process and addressing any challenges faced.

The scheme has also been recognized for its role in promoting gender equality.

By providing financial assistance, it empowers women and their families.

The initiative has garnered positive responses from various stakeholders.

Community leaders and local organizations have praised the scheme for its impact.

The scheme is also seen as a step towards enhancing the socio-economic status of women in Haryana.

In addition to financial assistance, the scheme promotes the importance of education for women.

It encourages families to invest in the education of their daughters.

This is crucial for ensuring long-term empowerment and independence.

The Haryana government is committed to expanding the reach of this scheme.

Plans are underway to enhance the application process through digital platforms.

This will make it easier for applicants to access information and submit applications.

The government aims to ensure that no eligible woman is left without support during her marriage.

Overall, the Financial Assistance in Marriage of Women Workers or Daughters of Workers scheme is a significant welfare initiative.

It addresses the financial challenges faced by women and their families in Haryana.

The scheme reflects the government's dedication to improving the lives of women workers.

By providing targeted financial assistance, it aims to foster a more equitable society.

The scheme is a vital part of Haryana's efforts to promote women's rights and welfare.

It stands as a testament to the state's commitment to social justice and empowerment.
